paper.title_en: Geometrically Significant Surfaces of Black Holes from a Single Scalar
paper.abstract_en: Black hole spacetimes contain several geometrically distinguished hypersurfaces, including event and Cauchy horizons, stationary-limit surfaces, and curvature singularities. These structures are usually identified by different geometric or causal criteria. We show that, for the Kerr--Newman black hole, the membrane-paradigm pressure of a stretched horizon admits an analytically continued scalar representative whose fully factorized form has zeros, poles, and singular factors aligned with these standard Kerr--Newman loci. Its zeros occur at the outer and inner horizons, its poles occur at the outer and inner stationary-limit surfaces, its higher-order divergence contains the ring-singularity factor, and its large-$r$ behavior records the asymptotic decay of the scalar. The construction is not proposed as a new invariant characterization of the spacetime, nor as a physical extension of the membrane fluid into the black-hole interior. Rather, it gives a compact membrane-pressure-based diagnostic whose analytic structure reorganizes several familiar surfaces of the Kerr--Newman geometry. We also note a secondary, purely algebraic analogy with generalized multi-component van der Waals-type equations of state.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文考察 Kerr--Newman 黑洞中多个几何显著曲面（事件视界、Cauchy 视界、稳态极限面、环奇点）与拉伸视界膜范式压强解析延拓标量表示之间的关系，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞几何的核心议题；构造紧凑且明确声明不是新的不变量刻画或物理延拓，理论深度中等偏好。
decision.title_zh: 来自单个标量的黑洞几何显著曲面
decision.abstract_zh: 黑洞时空包含若干几何上可区分的超曲面，包括事件视界与Cauchy视界、稳态极限面以及曲率奇点。这些结构通常由不同的几何或因果判据来识别。我们表明，对于Kerr--Newman黑洞，拉伸视界的膜范式压强允许一个解析延拓的标量代表，其完全因子化形式的零点、极点与奇异因子与这些标准的Kerr--Newman位置相对应。其零点出现在外视界与内视界处，其极点出现在外稳态极限面与内稳态极限面处，其高阶发散包含环奇点因子，而其大-$r$行为记录了标量的渐近衰减。该构造并非被提出作为时空的新的不变量刻画，也并非作为膜流体向黑洞内部的物理延拓。相反，它给出一个紧凑的基于膜压强的诊断量，其解析结构重新组织Kerr--Newman几何中若干熟悉的曲面。我们还注意到与广义多分量van der Waals型状态方程的一个次要的、纯代数的类比。
